commands.copy: Copy edited screenshot to the clipboard

tools.annotate: Renders annotations (rect, arrow, line, freehand, text, marker, highlight, redact with mode pixelate|blur|black, crop) onto a PNG below .rbrowser/out/ and writes the edited image and its annotations below .rbrowser/out/screenshot-editor/ (or at `out` there). Redactions are rendered into the pixels; the export has no metadata. Answers the path.
tools.load: One chunk (base64, from `offset`) of a PNG below .rbrowser/out/. The first answer also gives its width, height, saved annotations and `hash`; when they leave no room its `data` is empty and `next` is 0, and saved annotations larger than one answer stay out (`annotations_too_large`). Pass that `hash` with every later call. Without `image` the newest screenshot.
tools.list: The PNG files below .rbrowser/out/ the screenshot editor opens, the newest screenshots first.

color.label: Annotation colour
color.description: The colour a new annotation starts with.
color.help: The colour a new annotation starts with, as #rrggbb. Example: #e53935 for red.

strokeWidth.label: Line width
strokeWidth.description: The line width of rectangles, arrows, lines and freehand strokes, in image pixels.
strokeWidth.help: The line width of rectangles, arrows, lines and freehand strokes, in image pixels. Example: 4.

fontSize.label: Text size
fontSize.description: The size of texts and number markers, in image pixels.
fontSize.help: The size of texts and number markers, in image pixels. Example: 20.

redactBlock.label: Redaction block size
redactBlock.description: The block size of a pixelated or blurred redaction, in image pixels; larger hides more.
redactBlock.help: The block size of a pixelated or blurred redaction, in image pixels; larger hides more. Example: 12.

format.label: Export format
format.description: PNG or JPEG for the edited image.
format.help: The file format of the edited image: png is lossless, jpeg is smaller.

jpegQuality.label: JPEG quality
jpegQuality.description: The quality of a JPEG export, 10 to 100.
jpegQuality.help: The quality of a JPEG export, 10 to 100; higher gives larger files. Example: 85.

errors.bad_annotation: An annotation does not fit: a value is missing, out of range, or there is more than one crop.
errors.path_outside: The screenshot editor opens PNG files below .rbrowser/out/ only and writes below .rbrowser/out/screenshot-editor/ only.
errors.not_png: The file is no readable PNG image.
errors.out_extension: The target must be a file name ending in .png, .jpg or .jpeg.
errors.image_too_large: The image is too large for the editor: at most 16384 pixels a side and 25 megapixels.
errors.encode_failed: The edited image could not be encoded.
errors.output_too_large: The edited image is larger than the 8 MiB a plugin may write, even compressed harder. Crop it or export it as JPEG.
errors.no_screenshot: There is no screenshot in .rbrowser/out/screenshots/ yet.

panel.no_images: No PNG files in .rbrowser/out/ yet. Take a screenshot with Ctrl+Shift+Space C S.
panel.canvas: Screenshot {image} with {count, plural, one {# annotation} other {# annotations}}
panel.canvas_help: Drag on the image to draw. By keyboard: the arrow keys move the cursor (Shift: 10 px), Enter sets a point and Enter again the second, Escape cancels. Tools: R, A, L, F, T, M, H, B, C; the chosen tool's options stand beside the tools. Crop: drag a frame, adjust it by its handles, Enter applies it, Escape cancels, Ctrl+Z takes it back. Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Y redo, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+C copy, + and - zoom, 0 fits, Escape discards unsaved changes.
panel.changed: The file changed while it was loading; open it again.
panel.copied: The edited image is on the clipboard.
panel.copy_failed: The clipboard did not take the image ({error}). Save it and copy the file instead.
panel.second_point: Move to the second point and press Enter.
panel.discard_confirm: There are unsaved changes. Press Open again to discard them.
panel.too_large: Too many annotations for one save; remove some freehand strokes.
panel.crop_hint: Drag a frame on the image and adjust it by its handles; Enter applies, Escape cancels.
panel.crop_draft: Adjust the frame by its handles; Enter applies the crop, Escape cancels.
panel.crop_applied: Cropped to {width} x {height} px. Ctrl+Z takes it back; the original file stays as it is.
panel.annotations_too_large: The saved annotations of this image are larger than the editor takes (64 KiB) and were left out; saving here replaces them.

host_error.too_large: The data was larger than one panel message may carry (64 KiB).
host_error.timed_out: The plugin did not answer in time.
host_error.busy: The plugin is still answering earlier requests; try again.
